skill.name: brand-guidelines
skill.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
skill.summary: Applies Anthropic-inspired brand colors and typography guidance to visual artifacts.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

content.value_statement: Teams often need consistent brand styling across slides, documents, and visual artifacts. This skill provides color, typography, and styling rules that Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can apply.
actual_capabilities: Defines main and accent color roles for branded visual work.
Specifies heading and body font choices with fallback fonts.
Guides text styling based on hierarchy and background contrast.
Explains how to apply accent colors to non-text shapes.
Documents color use for python-pptx RGBColor workflows.
limitations: It does not install fonts or other design assets.
It does not verify current official brand rules from Anthropic.
It does not generate complete brand systems by itself.
It provides guidance, not automated design quality review.

use_cases.title: Style Client Presentations
use_cases.description: Apply consistent colors, fonts, and accent styling to a presentation before delivery.

use_cases.title: Standardize Internal Documents
use_cases.description: Convert reports or briefs to a shared visual style with clear hierarchy and readable contrast.

use_cases.title: Guide Design Implementation
use_cases.description: Give developers exact style rules for branded slides or generated visual assets.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Styling
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the brand guidelines to this artifact. Update colors, headings, body text, and accents while preserving the existing content.

prompt_templates.title: Style a Presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this slide deck using the brand guidelines. Improve hierarchy, contrast, and accent color use without changing the message.

prompt_templates.title: Review Brand Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this artifact for brand consistency. List styling issues, explain the guideline each issue violates, and propose concise fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Styling Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the generation workflow to apply these brand rules automatically. Preserve content structure and document any styling assumptions.

output_examples.input: A slide deck uses mixed fonts, low contrast body text, and random accent colors.
output_examples.output: The deck uses consistent heading and body fonts, improved text contrast, and a controlled accent color sequence.

output_examples.input: A report needs a branded visual pass before stakeholder review.
output_examples.output: The report receives updated headings, readable body styling, subtle backgrounds, and consistent secondary elements.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to map brand colors into a presentation script.
output_examples.output: The response explains which colors to use for text, backgrounds, accents, and non-text shapes.

best_practices: Provide the artifact type and target format before asking for styling.
Ask for contrast checks when styling dense text or small labels.
Confirm font availability when exact typography matters.
anti_patterns: Do not apply accent colors randomly across important content.
Do not reduce readability to force a visual style.
Do not treat this skill as a source for legal brand approval.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps apply brand colors, typography, and accent styling to visual artifacts.

faq.question: Does it install fonts?
faq.answer: No. It recommends fonts and fallback fonts, but it does not install them.

faq.question: Can it style PowerPoint files?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance references presentation styling and python-pptx color workflows.

faq.question: Does it verify official brand compliance?
faq.answer: No. It provides local guidance from the skill file and does not check external brand sources.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I provide with my request?
faq.answer: Provide the artifact, target format, audience, and any required brand constraints.
